historical_reviews.deepseek: Kernel/RAS logs are useful corroboration but cannot prove the NIC's DevSta/LnkSta/CESta/UESta fields; tails can hide earlier relevant events and absence of output is not proof when permissions or services fail.

original_test_intent: Verify that the intended PCIe NIC and its relevant PCIe path show the expected link state and no disallowed correctable or uncorrectable AER/device-status indications during the defined observation window.
original_method: Map NIC serial/PN/netdev to exact domain:bus:device.function and upstream bridge/root port; approve/install pciutils and optional platform RAS tooling; capture complete privileged `lspci -s <BDF> -vvv` for endpoint and relevant path before and after the window; extract DevSta/LnkSta/CESta/UESta and capability availability; preserve timestamped kernel/journal/rasdaemon records; compare sticky bits and new events to explicit masks/severity policy without resets or clears.
manual_activity: The PCIe/platform owner confirms NIC/path identity, privileges and expected status masks; the agent can collect and parse read-only config-space and time-bounded log evidence.
required_inputs: SUT, NIC PN/serial, netdev/driver/firmware and exact endpoint domain:BDF
Upstream switch/downstream/root-port BDF chain and which functions own AER reporting
Supported pciutils version, required privilege and optional rasdaemon package/service/database provenance
Expected DevSta/LnkSta/CESta/UESta flags, negotiated speed/width and allowed CE/UE masks
Observation-window baseline, sticky-bit/historical-event policy and severity/escalation thresholds
Pinned reviewed internal Script revision and secure access
safety_requirements: Use read-only config/log collection; do not reset NIC/link, clear AER/status, inject errors or change PCI config space
Verify exact BDF-to-NIC identity and upstream path before interpreting output
Require complete privileged output and command exit status; missing capabilities or permission failures are not no-error results
Preserve full timestamped logs and rasdaemon data; do not tail away or clear historical evidence
Use secure injected credentials and verified host identity
Escalate new fatal/nonfatal errors, link downgrade/retrain, device disappearance or increasing correctable errors without automatic repair/retry
agent_execution_scope: Verify pciutils/tool versions, permissions and endpoint/path identity
Collect complete source-aligned lspci views plus full timestamped kernel/journal/optional rasdaemon evidence
Parse named fields and compare before/after bits/events to the approved mask and link oracle
Do not install without approval, clear/reset/inject, guess BDF or masks, truncate evidence or decide PASS/FAIL
engineer_actions: Approve package/privilege and exact NIC/upstream-path mapping
Define expected link and DevSta/CESta/UESta masks plus historical/sticky policy
Approve observation window and escalation thresholds
Review parsed evidence and issue the DUT verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Mismatch as primary coverage: dmesg/rasdaemon do not replace `lspci -s <device id> -vvv`, and truncated filters can hide events. `lspci` comes from pciutils, not coreutils.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Run complete privileged `lspci -s <verified-domain:BDF> -vvv` at defined checkpoints for the endpoint and relevant path; preserve full timestamped kernel/journal and approved rasdaemon evidence without clearing or tail-only filtering.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Target-specific lspci `-vvv`, DevSta/LnkSta/CESta/UESta fields, no-error criterion, Common branch, internal Script reference and 15/5-minute estimate are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Compare complete endpoint/path PCIe status and time-bounded error records against explicit masks, retaining sticky history and topology identity.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds upstream ownership, privilege/tool provenance, bit-level oracle, before/after window and full-log correlation without altering the source command.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No grep output or command exit0 does not prove status bits are clear, capabilities were readable, the BDF is correct or the link is at expected speed/width.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: PCIe/AER status bits and rasdaemon records can be cumulative; passive inspection cannot prove injection/recovery handling.

review_improvement: Restores the omitted source config-space check, corrects the package identity and adds endpoint/path mapping, bit-level masks and complete time-window evidence without clearing sticky errors.
independent_technical_reasoning: AER evidence is split between endpoint status/capability registers, upstream/root-port reporting and OS logs. Kernel or rasdaemon silence cannot prove the endpoint DevSta/CESta/UESta fields are acceptable, while sticky bits may predate the test window. `lspci -vvv` can also omit detail when unprivileged. Therefore identity, privilege and complete before/after output are necessary, and each named flag must be judged against a project mask rather than a generic string search.
